Ann and Cara are two slots apart with Hana between them. Dev, Cara, Hana, Ann, Ben, Ivo, Finn, Gus, Elif fill slots 1 to 9 in that order, and every constraint holds.

I also checked uniqueness. Dev < Cara < Ivo, and Ivo must start a three-slot block (Ivo, Finn, Gus), so Ivo is 4 to 7. Ivo = 4 and Ivo = 5 fail, and so do Ivo = 6 with Cara = 3 or 4. Ivo = 7 fails for every value of Cara. Only Ivo = 6 with Cara = 2 survives.
